_comment: apps/website, the marketing site. Its Sentry project is onlooker-marketing
(id 4512074226401280, the `project` below). Renamed from Sentry's Astro-
wizard default on 2026-09-20; the id did not change and never does.
Scoped to production like the other two, and here that filter earns its
keep in a way worth stating: sentry.client.config.ts hard-codes the DSN,
so `pnpm dev` on somebody's laptop reports to this same project as
environment 'development'. An unscoped rule here does not merely risk
staging noise - it emails a human every time a developer makes a mistake
This replaces the default rule Sentry created with the project, which was
active, unscoped, and firing on exactly that.
